title: 雨夜咖啡馆的时间循环

storyBible.worldAnchor: Cozy late‑night café interior in a Chinese rural town, warm amber lighting reflecting off wet windows, subtle rain outside, quiet ambience, soft focus on characters.

characters.name: The Protagonist
characters.anchorPrompt: Young adult with thoughtful eyes, hair damp from rain, wearing a soft cardigan and dark jeans.

props.name: Coffee Mug
props.anchorPrompt: Ceramic coffee mug, dark brown, slightly chipped rim, resting on a wooden table, steam curling from a fresh brew.

locations.name: Rainy Night Café
locations.anchorPrompt: Small, dimly lit café interior, wooden tables, low lamps, rain tapping the roof, faint steam rising from coffee cups, cozy and intimate.

eventChain: Opening: Protagonist realizes that tonight’s choice will alter everyone’s fate.
Choice: Protagonist chooses to investigate the anomaly or protect a companion.
Result 1: Protagonist follows clues, discovers a repeating pattern.
Result 2: Protagonist protects companions, misses clue, gains deeper trust.
Ending 1: Protagonist breaks the loop and walks into a new dawn.
Ending 2: Protagonist keeps the secret, world remains, but knows how to choose next time.
